items.title: Masked men fire at Punjab home of singer who was close to Sidhu Moosewala
items.body: Masked assailants fired six shots at Punjabi singer Gulab Sidhu's home early Sunday morning. No injuries were reported as the singer was abroad promoting his new film. CCTV footage captured the incident which occurred at 1:33 am. Police registered a case of attempt to murder and under the Arms Act. An unverified audio clip claimed responsibility for the attack.

items.title: Pakistan’s England nightmare deepens: 11 WTC points docked, 50% fine — here’s why
items.body: Pakistan lost eleven World Test Championship points and faced a fifty percent match fee fine. This penalty resulted from a slow over-rate during their Test series against England. The team suffered a disappointing 3-0 series defeat in Birmingham. Pakistan captain Babar Azam accepted the proposed sanction for the offense. This deduction further impacts Pakistan's standing in the WTC standings.

items.title: ‘I work in Army’: Gurgaon hit-and-run car owner claims friend took car 2 days ago
items.body: The car owner stated his vehicle was borrowed by a friend two days prior. He learned about the alleged hit-and-run incident only on Monday morning. A woman biker shared a video showing a car hitting her motorcycle and fleeing. Gurgaon Police have taken suo motu cognisance of the viral video. The accused will be identified and arrested soon for legal action.

items.title: Inside Brics 2026: Video captures PM Modi’s candid moments with Xi, Putin and Prabowo
items.body: The Brics Summit 2026 took place in New Delhi on September 12 and 13, showcasing previously unseen moments of camaraderie among global leaders. Prime Minister Narendra Modi engaged in meaningful discussions with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, as well as Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto. The event underscored India's leadership in addressing international cooperation and pressing global challenges.

items.title: Aaditya Thackeray, Rhea Chakraborty named in Disha death case: Key details from CBI FIR
Yogalakshmi reveals her role in Silambarasan’s ‘Arasan’
items.body: <![CDATA[Yogalakshmi discovered she would star alongside Silambarasan TR in the film 'Arasan' during a conversation with director Vetrimaaran. Although she had another project lined up, she made the choice to join this exciting collaboration instead. With music composed by Anirudh Ravichander, 'Arasan' is drawing considerable attention and is set for release in 2027, with a sneak peek expected soon.

items.title: Yash, Nayanthara and Kiara Advani’s ‘Toxic’ OTT release date
items.body: <![CDATA[Yash's much-anticipated film 'Toxic' is set to premiere on ZEE5 digitally on September 25, 2026, after its theatrical release. However, insiders reveal that due to its underwhelming box office performance, there's pressure regarding its digital rights. The makers are currently negotiating for a more lucrative deal, and an official announcement about the OTT premiere date is still pending.

items.title: All you need to know about the ‘Insidious: Out of the Further’ OTT release
items.body: <![CDATA[Insidious: Out of the Further is ready to hit streaming platforms, following its release in theaters on August 21, 2026. Reports indicate that the film will make its online debut roughly 120 days after the cinema premiere. This installment uniquely focuses on Gemma's journey into The Further, with fans looking forward to the digital release anticipated in December.

items.title: 1920: Cold Winter: Anya Singh leads Vikram Bhatt horror
items.body: <![CDATA[Anya Singh joins Vikram Bhatt's '1920: Cold Winter' as female lead, reuniting with 'Border 2' co-star Ahan Shetty. Bhatt and Anand Pandit announced the film after 'Haunted – Echoes Of The Past's success; Shetty signed on in July 2026. Filming begins in November. It's the sixth instalment in the horror franchise that began in 2008.

items.title: ‘Mookuthi Amman 2’ teaser: Nayanthara transforms into ‘Mahasakthi’
items.body: <![CDATA[In the highly anticipated sequel 'Mookuthi Amman 2', Nayanthara returns as the formidable Mahakali, showcasing even more captivating action and spiritual fervor. With a theatrical release scheduled for November 6, coinciding with Diwali celebrations, this film is geared up to create a buzz at the box office, standing toe-to-toe with Ranbir Kapoor's 'Ramayana'. It promises an even more spectacular experience than the first installment.

items.title: 'Avengers Endgame: Encore': Re-release eyes Rs 10 crore debut
items.body: <![CDATA[Avengers Endgame Encore is returning to cinemas with new footage. This re-release aims to build anticipation for the upcoming Avengers Doomsday. Advance ticket sales have opened strongly in India for the September 25 release. The film is projected to achieve a double-digit opening in the Indian market. Encore screenings will offer fans a chance to revisit the Infinity Saga conclusion.

items.title: Nafisa starts targeted therapy: actor says cancer has progressed
items.body: <![CDATA[Nafisa Ali revealed her stage 4 ovarian cancer has spread to her liver's surface, shifting her treatment to targeted therapy. Sharing a hospital bed photo on Instagram, she called it "fighting the good fight." Fashion designer Farah Khan Ali and others sent support. Nafisa, diagnosed in 2018, remains treatment-focused while based in Goa.

items.title: 'Odiyan: The Age of Illusion' goes on floors
items.body: <![CDATA[Production has kicked off for Odiyan: The Age of Illusion, an intriguing horror mystery starring Prithviraj Sukumaran and Manju Warrier. This film, rooted in the rich tapestry of 19th-century Kerala folklore, seeks to immerse audiences in its eerie storytelling. With Rahul Sadasivan at the helm, the film reflects a significant partnership between Prithviraj Productions and Dharma Productions.

items.title: Fans praise 'Ramayana' IMPROVED visuals - WATCH
items.body: <![CDATA[The first song from Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana, 'Jai Jai Ram', has been released. This release offers fans a closer look at Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi as Rama and Sita. Fans have praised the music and noted significant visual and VFX upgrades in the video. The filmmakers are reportedly refining visuals based on audience feedback and earlier reactions.

items.title: Varma-Suri gangster drama: RGV details Mumbai underworld story
items.body: <![CDATA[Ram Gopal Varma announced a new collaboration with Mohit Suri, writing and co-producing a film Mohit will direct. Set during the Dawood Ibrahim-Chota Rajan split over Sautya, the story ties into the 1993 blasts aftermath. RGV praised Mohit's flair and claimed the film would be bigger than 'Dhurandhar'. Casting remains unknown.

items.title: Quote of the day by Arnold Schwarzenegger
items.body: <![CDATA[Arnold Schwarzenegger attributes his lasting drive to having a well-defined vision for his aspirations. His remarkable journey from bodybuilding champion to Hollywood icon and public servant demonstrates how a clear direction can help conquer obstacles and stay focused. This principle remains relevant, illustrating that a specific goal helps guide minor choices, allowing individuals to progress steadily in both personal and professional lives.

items.title: Main Hoon Hero Tera row: Amaal slams Salman Khan Films; clarifies it’s not at SalmanMain Hoon Hero Tera Credit Row: Amaal Mallik slams Salman Khan Films; clarifies it’s not at Salman
items.body: <![CDATA[Amaal Mallik called out Salman Khan Films for not crediting him and lyricist Kumaar for 'Main Hoon Hero Tera' from 'Hero' (2015), despite Salman Khan's post marking its 11th anniversary. Mallik clarified his criticism targets the production banner, not Khan himself, calling the lack of music-industry credit a decades-old issue.

items.title: Dhanush and Mammootty’s ‘OM’ confirms October 16 release
items.body: <![CDATA[The creators of 'OM' have officially unveiled a new poster for Vinayagar Chaturthi, confirming its release on October 16. This announcement quashes any rumors surrounding a delay for the eagerly awaited film. The theatrical debut will coincide with Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2,' which arrives a day earlier on October 15, setting the stage for an exciting face-off at the box office as Tamil cinema enthusiasts gear up for the duel.

items.title: 'Mirzapur: The Movie' sequel in talks as film crosses Rs 180 crore in India
items.body: <![CDATA[The success of 'Mirzapur: The Movie' has reportedly prompted Excel Entertainment to consider a second theatrical film in the popular franchise. After crossing Rs. 170 crore at the domestic box office, the makers are evaluating whether the characters can return to cinemas. The cast, director Gurmmeet Singh and writer Puneet Krishna are expected to meet producers Farhan Akhtar and Ritesh Sidhwani to discuss potential ideas, while the fourth season of the series remains in development.

items.title: Emmy Awards 2026 in India: When and where to watch
items.body: <![CDATA[The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards will stream live on JioHotstar for Indian viewers. Mariska Hargitay will host the prestigious television industry event. Viewers in India can watch the ceremony starting early September 15. 'The Pitt' leads nominations with twenty-five, while 'Hacks' follows closely. The awards will honor outstanding television productions across various categories.

items.title: ‘Mandaadi’ budget and cast salaries revealed: Soori takes home Rs 20 crore
items.body: <![CDATA[Mandaadi, directed by Soori, has garnered attention due to its gritty portrayal of a coastal community's struggle against the relentless sea. With a generous budget of around seventy-five crore rupees, Soori’s compensation was reported at twenty crore rupees for his lead role. The film's remarkable performance at the box office within just four days highlights its compelling storytelling and powerful performances.

items.title: 'Mirzapur The Movie' BO Day 11 [LIVE]: Pankaj Tripathi film crosses Rs 185 crore India net
items.body: <![CDATA['Mirzapur The Movie' has powered past the Rs. 184 crore mark in India as it enters Day 11, buoyed by a second weekend that brought in double-digit numbers on both Day 9 and Day 10. The Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Ravi Kishan starrer has now pushed its worldwide gross beyond Rs. 266 crore, keeping alive the possibility of the film inching towards the Rs. 200 crore India net club in the days ahead.

items.title: Hayden Panettiere’s ex Brian Hickerson detained
items.body: <![CDATA[In a shocking turn of events, Brian Hickerson, the former boyfriend of Hayden Panettiere, was arrested following a bar fight where he yelled about Panettiere's death despite being restrained by law enforcement. Alongside him, his brother Zach faced disorderly conduct charges. The brothers were reportedly with Panettiere when she was discovered unresponsive, and the investigation surrounding her untimely demise continues to unfold.

items.title: RamBola: Vishal Chaturvedi announce Tulsidas biopic
items.body: <![CDATA[Mahaveer Jain Films and writer-director Vishal Chaturvedi, after 'Hanuman Ansh', announced 'RamBola', tracing Goswami Tulsidas's life and spiritual legacy. Produced by Jain, Chaturvedi, Amit Upadhyay and Raghuvendra Singh, the film explores the Bharatiya Sant Parampara. Mahaveer Jain Films' upcoming slate also includes 'Naagzilla', 'Yeh Prem Mol Liya', and 'White'.

items.title: ‘We are never enemies’: Ajith’s old statement on Vijay goes viral
items.body: <![CDATA[At Silverstone, Tamil cinema icons Ajith Kumar and Vijay reunited, sparking excitement among their fans. Their affectionate greeting and embrace highlighted a camaraderie often mistaken for rivalry. This heartwarming encounter, which garnered significant online buzz, reminded fans that their professional competition is devoid of any personal hostility. Many were thrilled to witness this unexpected moment, celebrating the bond between the two stars.

The Union Minister adds that the T3 Terminal will be ready by April 2027

items.title: Six years after 2020 heartbreak, Zverev beats Shelton to finally win US Open
items.body: Alexander Zverev triumphantly claimed his second Grand Slam title at the US Open, overcoming American contender Ben Shelton in a gritty four-set battle. This prestigious win not only solidified Zverev's comeback from his 2020 US Open final loss but also capped off an extraordinary 2026 season, where he further set records with his remarkable prize money earnings.

‘We are the champions’: Muzumdar backs BCCI as India snub Mohsin Naqvi again
items.body: In a striking stand, India's women's cricket team refused to accept the Asia Cup trophy, aligning with the BCCI's stance as articulated by head coach Amol Muzumdar. Following their spectacular eighth Asia Cup victory against Sri Lanka, the players prioritised the significance of their achievement, choosing to celebrate their win over participating in the trophy handover ceremony.

items.title: Gujarat to global: How idea to fix pollution has lessons for Delhi
items.body: An Indian emissions trading scheme is now inspiring global environmental solutions. This innovative approach incentivizes industries to reduce pollution effectively. Gujarat's successful pilot program demonstrated significant emission reductions and cost savings. The scheme is now expanding across India and attracting international interest. This model offers a competitive advantage for industries embracing cleaner practices.

items.title: ABVP protests Umar Khalid documentary screening at NLSIU
items.body: The National Law School of India University became the site of a protest by Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad, who opposed an upcoming documentary about activist Umar Khalid, currently in prison. The group voiced concerns over the documentary's potential influence on campus culture and called for the cancellation of the event, which was timed to align with Political Prisoners Day. The university had not yet reached a conclusion about the screening.

items.title: Sundar Pichai’s IIT batchmate became a monk; what he told Google CEO years later
items.body: Sundar Pichai, the CEO of Google, and Gauranga Das, an ISKCON monk, were IIT classmates back in 1993. Decades later, they reunited to explore their divergent journeys. Pichai leads a globally recognized tech powerhouse known for its stress-laden environment, while Das embraces a tranquil, faith-driven life. Their engaging conversation showcased the variety of success stories stemming from their shared educational background.

items.title: ‘We spy on them too’: Trump shrugs off China-Iran satellite imagery report
items.body: President Trump has dismissed concerns regarding reports that Chinese entities are providing Iran with satellite imagery, suggesting that such espionage practices are not unlike those employed by the United States. This incident reportedly occurred just before a missile strike that resulted in the deaths of three American soldiers. With a meeting scheduled with Chinese President Xi Jinping, this satellite connection could create tension during their impending trade and technology negotiations.

items.title: Murder accused's 'victory march': SC asks Haryana police to produce him in court
Billionaire David Sacks to Sam Altman and Dario Amodei's call to slowdown AI development
items.body: David Sacks has sharply criticized Sam Altman and Dario Amodei's calls for slowing AI development. He urged the tech leaders to halt their work voluntarily if they believe models pose threats. Sacks argued that OpenAI and Anthropic already control the industry's pace and capabilities. He also suggested their motivation might be financial liability rather than pure altruism. Sacks believes immediate voluntary action would build significant goodwill for future discussions.

items.title: Russia targeting EU, UK officials? Ukraine’s big claim after drone strike
Oil prices jump over 2% as fresh Saudi, Strait of Hormuz strikes fuel supply fears
Vaibhav Sooryavanshi on the bench: Why India's bold T20I vision feels incomplete
items.body: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's omission from the first T20I against Afghanistan has reignited India's biggest selection debate: experience versus explosive potential. While Sanju Samson failed to capitalise on his opportunity in England, the 15-year-old's remarkable Zimbabwe series and India's long-term attacking philosophy make a compelling case for persistence. The real question is whether India will truly back the talent it fast-tracked.

items.title: 'Upset' Ford hits back at US transport secretary; says: Your letter is factually wrong
items.body: In a recent statement, US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy encouraged Ford to cut its partnership with CATL and Geely. He voiced significant worries regarding Ford's increasing reliance on strategic rivals. However, Ford dismissed these concerns as a mere publicity stunt, emphasizing its commitment to American investments and the operation of its Michigan battery facility, which provides employment to local workers.

items.title: Trump eyes Iran oil, hints at Venezuela-style US control after war
items.body: In a bold statement, President Trump hinted that the U.S. could take control of Iran's oil resources following a potential conflict. He likened this situation to the American involvement in Venezuela's oil industry. Trump anticipates the war may end before the November elections, asserting that Iran desires an agreement, yet only if it meets U.S. criteria. This strategy connects the U.S. presence to Iran's oil wealth and security aspirations.

items.title: After killing wife, 3 daughters, Jaipur man fled to temple seeking ‘divine blessings’
items.body: A man absconding after his wife and three daughters' murders was arrested Sunday. Rahul Jha was tracked down using CCTV footage and information from hotel staff. He confessed to the murders, citing family discord and strained relationships. Police recovered blood-stained clothes and his switched-off mobile phone from the home. The accused was brought to Jaipur after his apprehension in Reengus.

items.title: Shot down over Iran, hunted for 50 hrs: How US fighter survived behind enemy lines
items.body: A US Air Force officer survived nearly fifty hours in Iran after his jet was shot down. Over ninety American service members deployed for one of the most complex rescue operations. The officer, injured, hid in Iran's desert while Iranian forces searched for him. US forces used bombers and drones to strike Iranian Revolutionary Guard forces nearby. This mission demonstrated the US commitment to recovering its personnel.

items.title: Kargil War veteran attacked with iron rod in Gurgaon over parking row
items.body: A retired Group Captain of the Indian Air Force fell victim to a violent attack by a parking attendant, resulting in serious injuries, including head trauma and a broken hand. The confrontation occurred over a parking dispute at Magnum Global Park, where the attendant reportedly wielded an iron rod. Following the incident, police have received a complaint aimed at launching an attempted murder investigation.

items.title: ‘We can’t receive trophy from him’: Why India snubbed Mohsin Naqvi again
items.body: India's women's cricket team made headlines by declining to participate in the Women's Asia Cup trophy presentation, standing in unity with the men's team from last year. The BCCI secretary linked this move to current military tensions with a neighboring nation. Celebrating their impressive eighth Women's Asia Cup title, the team now looks ahead to the Asian Games, with a focus on capturing gold.

items.title: Christian Bale opens foster care village: 'Bruce Wayne started orphanages...'
items.body: <![CDATA[Christian Bale has opened a new foster care village in Palmdale. This facility, named Together California, prioritizes keeping siblings together. The village offers a safe and nurturing environment for children and their families. Bale was inspired by his sister's brief foster care experience. The project was funded through donations, raising nearly nine million dollars.

items.title: Tom Holland becomes highest-grossing actor of all time
items.body: <![CDATA[Spider-Man: Brand New Day is nearing significant box-office milestones globally and domestically. The film is projected to earn between USD 2.5 billion and USD 2.6 billion worldwide. It is also on track to claim the domestic box-office record from Star Wars: The Force Awakens. This success, along with The Odyssey, has made Tom Holland the highest-grossing actor. Holland's films have now generated over USD 15.5 billion globally.

items.title: In 2020, Zac Efron invested in a bushland; six years later, he is turning it into an eco-friendly hemp home
items.body: <![CDATA[In an inspiring move towards sustainability, Zac Efron is developing an eco-friendly hemp home on his bushland property in Australia, which he purchased six years ago. The innovative design, led by Joost Bakker, incorporates hemp blocks and biodegradable materials. This off-grid residence is set to be a peaceful haven, reflecting Efron's dedication to living harmoniously with nature.

items.title: 'I'm Game' BO day 11 vs 'Bethlehem Kudumba Unit'
items.body: <![CDATA[Dulquer Salmaan's latest film, 'I'm Game', experienced a lukewarm second weekend at the box office, garnering an India net total of Rs 24.92 crore. Meanwhile, Nivin Pauly's 'Bethlehem Kudumba Unit' is holding strong in theaters, with impressive India net earnings of Rs 146.40 crore and a worldwide gross collection of Rs 304.95 crore.

items.title: 'Mandaadi' BO day 4 vs 'Sardar 2'
items.body: <![CDATA[On its fourth day, Soori's 'Mandaadi' continued to demonstrate impressive theatrical performance, raking in over thirty-four crore rupees in net earnings within India. The film's total worldwide gross has surged to nearly forty-eight crore rupees. Meanwhile, Karthi's 'Sardar 2' experienced a slight increase in its collections, now totaling eleven crore rupees net in India, indicating a steady viewer interest.

items.title: 'Mirzapur: The Movie' box office day 10: Pankaj Tripathi starrer earns Rs 13.25 cr
items.body: <![CDATA[Mirzapur: The Movie earned Rs 13.25 crore on its tenth day, maintaining strong box office momentum. The film’s total India net collection has now reached Rs 184.70 crore after its first weekend. Overseas gross collections added Rs 4.00 crore on Sunday, pushing worldwide earnings higher. The crime drama’s narrative is set between Season 1 episodes, expanding the popular franchise. Pankaj Tripathi returns as Kaleen Bhaiya in this compelling story.

items.title: Yash, Tara Sutaria, Nayanthara, Kiara Advani starrer Toxic earns Rs 26 lakhs
items.body: <![CDATA[Yash's film 'Toxic' experienced a dip in earnings on its nineteenth day. The movie's total India net collection reached Rs 249.04 crore after Sunday. Overseas markets contributed Rs 43.50 crore to the worldwide gross. The Kannada version accounted for most of the film's domestic earnings. Kiara Advani recalled an exhausting yet memorable filming sequence.

items.title: Meghan Markle posts first family video from the UK
items.body: <![CDATA[Meghan Markle has shared her first family video since moving to the United Kingdom, showcasing Prince Harry and their children partaking in fun outdoor adventures. This heartwarming glimpse into their lives comes as a significant moment following their recent relocation. Additionally, Prince Harry is reportedly involved in a mysterious project in London. The family is said to have settled indefinitely to improve relationships with the royal family.

items.title: 'The Batman Part II' leaks tease Court of Owls connection - WATCH
items.body: <![CDATA[Production for The Batman Part II is underway in London, hinting at new character introductions. Leaked set photos suggest a possible connection to the Court of Owls and Anarky. Sebastian Stan and Scarlett Johansson are joining the expanding cast of the sequel. The film's release date has been delayed again to February 18, 2028. This gives the director additional time to complete the highly anticipated follow-up.

items.title: 'Irumudi' BO day 24 vs 'Epic: First Semester'
items.body: <![CDATA[Ravi Teja's 'Irumudi' continues its box office lead among smaller Telugu releases. The film recorded a notable increase on its twenty-fourth day. Meanwhile, Anand Deverakonda's 'Epic: First Semester' experienced a decline on its third day. 'Irumudi' has achieved substantial domestic and worldwide gross collections after four weeks. 'Epic: First Semester' has garnered moderate collections in its initial three days.

items.title: When Allu Arjun celebrated Ganesh Visarjan with daughter
items.body: <![CDATA[Actor Allu Arjun shared cherished family moments with his daughter Allu Arha during Ganesh Visarjan. He affectionately calls his daughter 'Daddy's Princess' in social media posts. Allu Arjun belongs to the influential Konidela-Allu family of Telugu cinema. He is preparing for the pan-Indian science-fiction action film 'Raaka'. The actor will also collaborate with Lokesh Kanagaraj for 'AA23'.

items.title: Liam Neeson and Stella Stocker hold hands at the TIFF red carpet
items.body: <![CDATA[Liam Neeson and Stella Stocker made a stylish appearance at TIFF 2026, turning heads as they walked the red carpet in coordinated black ensembles. They joined the cast of Courteney Cox's film 'Evil Genius' during its premiere. After previously collaborating on two 2022 films, the actors are excited for the launch of their new thriller 'The Mongoose' on October 30.

items.title: Allu Arjun and Basil Joseph meet again in Mumbai?
items.body: <![CDATA[In an exciting turn of events, Allu Arjun and Basil Joseph were spotted together in Mumbai, sparking rumors of an upcoming collaboration. Screenwriter Arun Anirudhan added fuel to the speculation by sharing snapshots from their meeting. Fans are eager to see how the renowned Malayalam filmmaker might partner with the Telugu superstar, although no official project announcements have been made yet.

items.title: 'Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle' set for OTT release - Details Inside
items.body: <![CDATA[Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle Part 1 arrives on Netflix US September 28. This anime blockbuster achieved significant box office success following its 2025 theatrical debut. The film earned over USD 793 million worldwide, becoming a global box office success. It shattered domestic opening records for an anime film, surpassing previous benchmarks. The story continues with Infinity Castle Part 2 currently in development.

items.title: Rishikanth and Anishma Anilkumar's 'Modha Rathiri' OTT release date
items.body: <![CDATA[The Tamil rural comedy film 'Modha Rathiri' is set for its digital debut soon. This movie will begin streaming on Netflix from September 18 in multiple languages. The film's straightforward storytelling and rural backdrop have drawn significant attention. National Award-winning actor Dhanush praised the film and its team of newcomers. This digital premiere offers a fresh reach to audiences who missed the theatrical release.

items.title: ‘SNL UK’ creates a skit about Meghan Markle and Prince Harry’s UK move
items.body: <![CDATA[Saturday Night Live UK brought the house down with a comedic skit about Meghan Markle and Prince Harry's adjustment to life away from royalty. The funny sketch featured actors as King Charles and Queen Camilla, who humorously monitored the couple's return, taking jabs at Meghan’s cooking and their earnings from Netflix. It cleverly emphasized their shift to private citizens while managing public personas in the commercial landscape.

items.title: 'Ramayana' begins musical journey with 'Jai Jai Ram' track
items.body: <![CDATA[The Ramayana film makers released its first song and a new poster on Ganesh Chaturthi. The song 'Jai Jai Ram' features music by AR Rahman and vocals by Shreya Ghoshal and Arijit Singh. A new poster shows Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama and Sai Pallavi as Sita in an intimate forest scene. This musical release marks the beginning of the film's promotional journey towards its release.

items.title: NSW fenced out cats and foxes; 13 locally extinct species returned
items.body: Thirteen native animal species have returned to New South Wales conservation reserves after a decade. These species had been locally extinct and are now breeding successfully within predator-proof fences. This conservation success is the result of a ten-year partnership involving government and scientific organizations. The state has now extended this vital conservation agreement for another ten years. Future efforts will focus on expanding these reintroductions beyond fenced areas.

Additionally, their droppings helped spread acacia seeds, promoting the growth of trees. Their natural movements resulted in water-retaining depressions, significantly transforming the area's ecology into a thriving environment that has caught global attention.

items.title: After Trump renames Lake Ontario, Republican wants Lake Erie renamed too
items.body: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order directing federal agencies to rename Lake Ontario as “Lake America” on US maps, documents and databases. Canada has rejected the move, while several US governors have also said they will continue calling it Lake Ontario. The decision comes amid rising trade tensions between Washington and Ottawa.

Houthi advances puts India and global trade closer to the edge
items.body: Houthi forces are close to seizing control of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, crucial for global shipping. This advance heightens concerns over trade security and energy supply chains around the world. India could experience rising costs and extended transit times for its goods. The Houthis are also enhancing their military capabilities, including integrating AI into weapons systems. This development poses new geopolitical challenges, especially for Pakistan and its defense alliances.

Tharoor answers Chidambaram’s questions on Brics benefits for India; BJP takes digs
items.body: Shashi Tharoor defended India's BRICS summit prestige in contrast to Chidambaram's questions on its tangible benefits. The BJP criticized Chidambaram's remarks and highlighted Tharoor's differing viewpoint. Tharoor stated hosting leaders shows diplomatic convening power and value. He also noted BRICS represents a majority of the world's population. Tharoor's independent views often create internal Congress party discussions.

items.title: Quote of the day by Gerard Butler
items.body: <![CDATA[Gerard Butler's remarkable ascent from a law student to a celebrated Hollywood star broke the mold of traditional pathways. With no previous experience or industry connections, he bravely ventured into acting in London. The challenges he faced along the way were pivotal, illustrating that embracing untraditional routes can yield unexpected rewards. His inspiring journey underlines the importance of resilience and patience in navigating life's uncertain landscape.

items.title: Elijah Wood finally gets Novato’s Key to the City after 30 years at City Hall
items.body: <![CDATA[A Key to the City prepared for child actor Elijah Wood after he filmed Radio Flyer in Novato in the early 1990s sat forgotten at City Hall for over 30 years. The honorary key was finally delivered when a fan met Wood at Fan Expo in San Francisco, leaving the actor surprised and touched.

items.title: Pranay Reddy Vanga challenges reviewers to prove themselves with ‘Spirit’
items.body: <![CDATA[Producer Pranay Reddy Vanga has boldly taken on film critics, urging them to evaluate the upcoming movie 'Spirit' by Sandeep Reddy Vanga with the same scrutiny as they did 'Romanchakam.' He contends that true filmmaking challenges can only be grasped through actual production experience, emphasizing that the success of a film at the box office isn't solely determined by reviews, but rather by the audience's ultimate judgment.
